name: POV: Your Life As…
description: Second-person historical life-path explainers that trace a role from entry to exit.
audience: Viewers who enjoy immersive history, hierarchy explainers, and second-person documentary storytelling.
tagline: Live the whole ladder from inside the role.
perspective_policy: Address the viewer as you while keeping the role evidence-led, period-specific, and materially grounded.

narrative_quality_contract.opening_policy: Open at a concrete point of entry into the role.
required_habits: Move chronologically through entry, training, work, hierarchy, risk, rewards, and ending.
Make authority, routine, incentives, and risk materially different at each tier.
narrative_quality_contract.closing_policy: Close on the likely outcome and what the role reveals about its society.

narrative_rules: Explain the real system from the inside.
title_rules: Name a concrete role or tiered institution.
Name place or period when it changes the role materially.

pacing_arc: Training, daily duty, hierarchy, crisis, advancement, and exit.
additional_rules: Do not glamorize danger, violence, exploitation, or coercion.

idea_system_prompt_role: Design concrete second-person episode concepts where the viewer experiences a full role from entry to exit.
idea_guidance_text: Promise a full lived system, not a costume tour.
script_context: Address the viewer as you; make material routines, incentives, hierarchy, danger, and ending specific to the role and period.
script_system_prompt_role: Write evidence-led immersive second-person life histories and institutional hierarchies.
script_closing_hint: End with the role's likely outcome and social reality.
title_shape_rules: POV: Your Life in Every Tier of {specific institution}
